description: Several newlines in a row separate object elements like one newline
notes: The grammar lists Newline as a separator between object elements, but the prose says newlines between the braces are ignored as whitespace, and prose has priority over the grammar, which leaves no newline separator. hashicorp/hcl makes newlines significant inside object constructors: parseObjectCons in hclsyntax/parser.go takes the first newline after an element as the separator and skips the others before the next key.
